fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: Trigger if OC does not beat the preregistered comparator, if target fields leak into design, or if the negative control retains advantage.

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: condition-intervention historical majority and phase-stratified outcome baseline
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict the held-out outcome direction from condition, intervention class, phase, and historical public outcome frequencies locked before the target slice.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: OC residual must improve over the phase-stratified baseline by the preregistered material margin under bootstrap uncertainty.

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

residual_requirement.superiority_rule: OC must beat the preregistered baseline with positive material margin and no target leakage.

residuals.material_margin_rule: OC must beat the preregistered baseline with positive material margin and no target leakage.

source.source_authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine, ClinicalTrials.gov
source.source_name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 studies and reported outcome modules

target_variable.extraction_rule: Lock completed interventional trials and hide reported primary outcome direction and biomarker shift fields until the OC scoring pack is preregistered.
target_variable.name: held_out_primary_outcome_effect_direction_and_biomarker_shift
target_variable.unit: directional effect class with reported outcome measure units retained per study

uncertainty_requirement.metric: bootstrap confidence interval over held-out outcome-direction residuals
uncertainty_requirement.rule: Report 95 percent bootstrap intervals and fail closed when intervals cross the materiality threshold.

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
